mysql.name: alert_events
mysql.create:
CREATE TABLE alert_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alert_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	symbol_id INTEGER, 
	data_json TEXT, 
	acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	portfolio_id INTEGER COMMENT '关联组合ID（可为空的系统级告警无此值）', 
	decision_run_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '关联决策运行ID；决策前系统告警（数据源/调度失败）可为NULL', 
	task_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '关联异步任务ID或correlation_id；系统告警必填其一；决策告警可同时有decision_run_id', 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '关联追踪跨服务请求ID；任一非决策告警此ID与task_id至少一个非空', 
	dedupe_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '30分钟窗口去重键=SHA256(portfolio_id:alert_code:severity:window_start)', 
	incident_no INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '同一dedupe_key恢复后再次发生自增1；事务锁或重试保障并发不重复' DEFAULT '1', 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ACTIVE | ACKNOWLEDGED | RESOLVED | SUPPRESSED' DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', 
	resolved_at DATETIME COMMENT '告警恢复或手动关闭时间；用于解除去重窗口', 
	window_start_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '30分钟去重窗口起点UTC naive；用于dedupe_key一致性', 
	severity_level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '告警等级 L3(INFO)/L2(WARN)/L1(CRITICAL)；默认L2；与message.severity可不一致（消息等级与事件等级解绑）' DEFAULT 'L2', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_alert_events_dedupe_incident UNIQUE (dedupe_key, incident_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_events_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','ACKNOWLEDGED','RESOLVED','SUPPRESSED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alert_events_severity_level CHECK (severity_level IN ('L3','L2','L1'))
)

mysql.name: async_tasks
mysql.create:
CREATE TABLE async_tasks (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	task_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	percent FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	total INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	processed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ok_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	current_item VARCHAR(64), 
	payload_json TEXT, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	errors_json TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at DATETIME, 
	stage_budget_seconds INTEGER, 
	stage_started_at DATETIME, 
	last_progress_at DATETIME, 
	last_progress_percent FLOAT, 
	current_step_description TEXT, 
	suggested_action TEXT, 
	batch_recovery_json TEXT, 
	last_patrol_at DATETIME, 
	worker_thread_id VARCHAR(32), 
	cancel_requested INTEGER, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) COMMENT '同事务去重键：task_type+portfolio_id+date+payload_hash+c id 生成；可用于 AC-10 重复投递 3 次零重复订单/成交', 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '跨 request/async_task/decision_run/outbox/audit 统一关联 ID；8 hex，同 main.py 异常处理器', 
	is_terminal_locked INTEGER COMMENT '终态锁定：status 进入 done/failed/cancelled 后置 1；之后任何 status/stage 改必须 WHERE !=1（project_memory #8 终态不得被 worker 线程覆盖）', 
	cancelled_timeout_at DATETIME COMMENT 'CANCEL 请求超时时间点；若之后仍无终态，巡检升级为 cancelled_timeout 审计记录（不打断 status=cancelled 的终态语义）', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

	reproducibility_reason TEXT COMMENT 'Why a run is legacy or cannot be replayed', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	member_snapshot_json TEXT COMMENT '成员快照 JSON：[{member_id, symbol_id, effective_from, effective_to, execution_mode, entry_rule_version_id, exit_rule_version_id}]', 
	symbol_ids_json TEXT COMMENT '标的 ID 列表 JSON', 
	excluded_members_json TEXT COMMENT '运行时排除的成员及原因 JSON：[{member_id, symbol_id, reason}]',

	filter_config_json TEXT COMMENT 'BacktestFilterConfig JSON 快照（运行时不可变）；NULL 为历史回测', 
	config_hash VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '过滤配置 SHA256 hex 指纹，用于复现/对账', 
	production_fidelity INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'BOOLEAN 0/1：1=生产保真(核心规则全开启)，0=非保真实验' DEFAULT '1', 
	non_fidelity_reason TEXT COMMENT '非保真原因字符串，如 ''filter_st disabled; filter_new_listing disabled''', 
	frontend_session_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'T11 10s dedup key: frontend session id', 
	stage VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'T11 stage enum: precheck|creating|queued|running|success|failed|blocked|cancelled' DEFAULT 'queued', 
	progress_pct FLOAT COMMENT 'T11 progress percent [0, 100], increments across stages' DEFAULT '0.0', 
	updated_at DATETIME COMMENT 'T11 auto-updated timestamp per stage/progress change', 
	error_code VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'T11 machine-readable error code', 
	retryable INTEGER COMMENT 'T11 BOOLEAN: retryable transient error' DEFAULT '0', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_decision_evidence_action_6values CHECK (action IN ('BUY','SELL','HOLD','NO_ACTION','REJECTED','DATA_BLOCKED')),

)

mysql.name: factor_evaluation_runs
mysql.create:
CREATE TABLE factor_evaluation_runs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	factor_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	universe_snapshot_id VARCHAR(64), 
	data_cutoff_at DATETIME, 
	target_code VARCHAR(32), 
	train_start_date DATETIME, 
	train_end_date DATETIME, 
	validation_start_date DATETIME, 
	validation_end_date DATETIME, 
	config_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	gate_result VARCHAR(24), 
	rejection_reasons_json TEXT, 
	artifact_path VARCHAR(512), 
	task_id VARCHAR(64), 
	created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	selected_trade_date VARCHAR(10), 
	observed_symbols INTEGER, 
	expected_symbols INTEGER, 
	completeness_ratio FLOAT, 
	fallback_reason TEXT, 
	filter_config_json TEXT COMMENT 'BacktestFilterConfig JSON 快照；NULL 为历史评价运行', 
	config_hash VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '过滤配置 SHA256 hex 指纹，用于复现', 
	production_fidelity INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'BOOLEAN 0/1：1=生产保真，0=非保真实验' DEFAULT '1', 
	non_fidelity_reason TEXT COMMENT '非保真原因字符串，如 ''filter_st disabled''', 
	raw_count INTEGER COMMENT '面板原始行数（未过滤前）', 
	filtered_count INTEGER COMMENT 'PIT 过滤后面板行数（分母）', 
	effective_count INTEGER COMMENT '最终计入 IC/分组/换手的有效行数（filtered - 标签缺失）', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

mysql.create:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '业务幂等键（如 pid:trade_date:run_type:req_hash 或前端 UUID 头透传值）', 
	entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'decision_run / portfolio_factor_usage / outbox / alert / order_plan', 
	entity_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '已创建实体ID（重复请求返回此实体，不重复创建）', 
	resource_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', 
	resource_id VARCHAR(128), 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCEEDED', 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '请求体 canonical JSON SHA256 —— 同 key 不同 hash → HTTP 409 参数冲突' DEFAULT '', 
	response_json TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'WP0-2 标准列：首次成功响应 canonical JSON（重放时原封不动返回）', 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '与 OutboxEvent / 审计事件 correlation_id 对齐，跨请求/事务/事件三链路串联' DEFAULT '', 
	portfolio_id INTEGER,

	executed_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '实际首次执行时间（通常=created_at；如果服务有延迟则≈首次落库时间）', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'WP0-2 标准列：幂等记录创建时间（≈executed_at）', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE portfolios (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

	asset_scope VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mixed', 
	total_capital DOUBLE NOT NULL, 
	investable_ratio FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	cash_reserve_ratio FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	is_default INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	auto_trade_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	auto_trade_last_run_at DATETIME, 
	auto_trade_source_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portfolio', 
	status_score VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'T-D1: Score 维度状态（缺 Score/超新鲜度 → SCORE_STALE）' DEFAULT 'READY', 
	status_data VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'T-D1: 数据完整度维度状态（DATA_BLOCKED/缺口 → DATA_INCOMPLETE_PAUSED）' DEFAULT 'READY', 
	status_model VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'T-D1: 模型/因子维度状态（active_model_run_id 缺失/切换未确认 → MODEL_INACTIVE）' DEFAULT 'READY', 
	status_reconciliation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'T-D1: 对账一致性维度状态（差异≠0/人工未复核通过 → RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED）' DEFAULT 'READY', 
	buy_fee_pct FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00025', 
	sell_fee_pct FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00025', 
	benchmark_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '000300', 
	default_single_position_pct FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.30', 
	is_test INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	key_members_json TEXT, 
	last_decision_trade_date DATE COMMENT '决策完成日=order_plan全落库+DecisionRun=SUCCEEDED后UPDATE；NULL=从未接管/从未决策成功', 
	last_reconciled_trade_date DATE COMMENT '对账完成日=T+1撮合成交+持仓刷新+对账差异=0后UPDATE；NULL=从未对账完成', 
	lease_key VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '租约持有标识（字符串随机值）；分布式调度抢锁用', 
	lease_expire_at DATETIME COMMENT '租约到期UTC naive时间；超过即可被其他worker抢锁', 
	effective_start_date DATE COMMENT '组合生效日；首次自动接管时从此日期后首个交易日开始；NULL=兼容老组合（使用created_at推断）', 
	auto_schedule_hour INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '正式auto_simulation调度小时；仅允许 20-23（应用层SCHEDULE_TOO_EARLY拦截）' DEFAULT '20', 
	auto_schedule_minute INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '正式auto_simulation调度分钟；0-59' DEFAULT '30', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_portfolios_status_score_values CHECK (status_score IN ('READY','RUNNING','SCORE_STALE','DATA_INCOMPLETE_PAUSED','MODEL_INACTIVE','RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_portfolios_status_data_values CHECK (status_data IN ('READY','RUNNING','SCORE_STALE','DATA_INCOMPLETE_PAUSED','MODEL_INACTIVE','RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_portfolios_status_model_values CHECK (status_model IN ('READY','RUNNING','SCORE_STALE','DATA_INCOMPLETE_PAUSED','MODEL_INACTIVE','RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_portfolios_status_reconciliation_values CHECK (status_reconciliation IN ('READY','RUNNING','SCORE_STALE','DATA_INCOMPLETE_PAUSED','MODEL_INACTIVE','RECONCILIATION_BLOCKED')), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

	param_hash VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'T-D6 用：参数指纹；同 key 但 param_hash 不一致 → 409 CONFLICT', 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_task_idempotencies_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_task_idempotencies_task_type_4values CHECK (task_type IN ('backtest','factor_calc','model_train','auto_trade'))
)

mysql.name: watchlists
mysql.create:
CREATE TABLE watchlists (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	list_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)
